notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 18 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4NmtGbfgA5USVGjtqEcqps?si=17c11135a8cb4f39) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec M+KB Controller): Backup PvE pick for use against Minor add groups in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content. The reprised Taraxippos returns without the weirdly great Gutshot Straight/Explosive Payload combination, although it is a lightweight frame, offering +20 Mobility and ×1.0625 movement speed which is always nice. At base, the stats are excellent by comparison with its peers - 30 Range and 19 Zoom equate to 69.91m ADS and 34.95m hipfire, 42 Stability is ×1.1495 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 69 Handling is 0.34s ready, 0.29s ADS and 0.32s stow speed, 59 Reload Speed is a 1.84s reload, Recoil Direction is 54, and base magazine size is 15 (max 20). Use the barrel perk help control the recoil or add Handling if you're on M+KB, and then the magazine perk can round out Reload Speed and/or bump up magazine size. In the first trait perk column, Enlightened Action stacks boost Handling and Reload Speed by up to +50 on weapon hits, or Fourth Time's the Charm extends your magazine on crit hits. As the second column damage trait perk, Explosive Payload boosts crit damage by ×1.1 and bodyshot damage by ×1.15 as well as flinching enemies, or High Ground either provides escalating damage on kills up to ×1.25, or ×1.25 damage for your feet being 2m or more higher then an enemy's lowest point. If you're interested, it's named after a ghost that's blamed for frightening horses at hippodromes throughout Greece. Classy Contender is an unspectacular origin trait, generating roughly 5% class ability energy on kills, or of you're a serial reloader, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boosts reload Speed and Stability in the top half of your magazine. Recommended MW: Handling with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, Synergy to create Strand Tangles or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Taraxippos returns to us again this Guardian Games. The OGs remember how mid this scout rifle was. Does it get better this year? Well kinda. Tear is great on all the weapons it rolls on and Hatchling also exists until you invest into it. High Ground is easy to proc for free damage. But nothing crazy for this refresh." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Taraxippos didn't make too much of a splash in PvP either, being able to use Cascade Point to blister down enemies. Now High Ground comes by and takes...well the high ground. Zen Moment will keep you on target, but I'd personally go with Kill Clip to keep things nice and easy." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "We [probably] have a scout in our vault we use for PvE. Do we need another? Well technically no. Taraxippos doesn’t do anything another scout couldn’t do equally or better. If you somehow don’t have one, then yeah. Grind yourself one out this Guardian Games. It’s easy to get and you’ll probably have more than you know what to do with." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "With the update to scout rifle damage, I think there’s a good case for this scout being a low-key meta choice. It won’t have as good of a feeling as the rapid-fire frames, nor the oomph of the high-impacts. But the extra movement speed and the extra flexibility could aid certain builds and loadouts. I love kill clip for really deleting guardians in 6s, but it falls off hard in 3s." Recommended MW: Handling.

SirStallion (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Scouts are weird. Lets just start there. I like the idea of scouts, but in practice.. Theyre just strange. BUT, they do one thing quite well.. Precision kills. So, between Enlightened Action keeping your reload up and making the gun feel snappy, and then Hatchling helping you dispatch groups of enemies at the same time, I think this roll has a lot of low end potential for fun. Which lets be honest.. Isn't that what we all want?" Recommended MW: Stability.

SirStallion (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Okay, heres my thought process.. EotS helps secure a kill.. Which leads into Kill Clip helping you secure another.. And another. And another. Next thing you know, you're making Shaxx proud and it's all because you've become a dueling monster and all the bonus Stability makes you unflinchable. That's the theory anyway, but in my hands? No way that works in practice." Recommended MW: Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 98 from 19 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0cxvW6vTZVWtwmXkqr7g1f?si=66932432408046d2) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. If you find a roll you like, keep for the ability to enhance perks when Final Shape arrives. Named after a ghost that frightened horses at a particular spot on the Olympia race course during ancient games there. Still the only Lightweight Strand scout rifle with pretty solid stats. For min-maxxers, the +20 Mobility from the intrinsic perk and +6.25% movement speed can help to flesh out builds. Taraxippos is fast-firing, so you will need to control the recoil, as well as flesh out the stats with the barrel perk. For the magazine perk, you're looking to reduce reload speed, or boost magazine size (or a bit of everything with Tactical Mag). Fourth Time's The Charm in the first trait column as your support perk is always welcome to extend your mag size, while Explosive Payload in the second column as the signature perk passively boosts PvE damage. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Or, Omolon Fluid Dynamics adds stability and reload speed to the top half of your mag. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Speedy reloads and threadlings? Heck yeah boi. Definitely go for Arrowhead Brake so you have a decent recoil direction. Lightweight scouts don't need much but anything helps. Tactical Mag or Appended Mag are going to be the best here. Small shout out to Flared Magwell, but with Outlaw you won't need a lot of reload. I'd take more bullets for this one." Recommended MW: Handling.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Moving Target is arguably the best in slot for the third column, and kill clip will allow for some spicy three taps. Definitely keep an eye out for this one. Again Arrowhead Brake is recommended for allowing you to focus less on controlling the recoil and more about crits. Steady Rounds will bump up the stability meaning you have less jump each shot. You shouldn't have to worry about the range drop as scouts have different metrics for range. Handling or stability for masterwork depending on how fast you like your weapons. [...] You won't necessarily need the range boost, but you don't need the stability boost from steady rounds either. So use that knowledge for what you'd like. There's no bad mag perk other than extended mag." Recommended MW: Handling.

SirStallion_ (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Everybody is going to be looking for Hatchling on this thing, so I'm not unique in that respect. A strand scout is new and unique, so leaning into that newness and uniqueness is great, absolutely worth it. However.. I am not going to be looking for Outlaw, instead I'm looking for FTTC. Just to be a bit special? Yes. But also, Tactical Mag should bring the gun to a nice 16 mag size, which will play nicely with FTTC. The reload from Tac and MW will be more than enough and they don't have a kill condition, so personally I don't think I need outlaw. Obligatory Arrowhead because even on a scout rifle, 54 RD is brutal." Recommended MW: Reload.

SirStallion_ (PvP / M+KB): "I just need to shoutout that Kill Clip is right there in slot 4 also, and that would be great too. However, my thought process with this roll is that I want to make any given engagement as easy for me as possible (High stab, Zen Moment) while also being as much of a nuisance for the enemy as I can (Low flinch intake, Explosive Payload) So while I do think the KC 3 taps will go hard, I'm here to be a menace, not a slayer. [...] While MnK won't actively benefit from Stability as much as Controller, the flinch resist is gonna be a big deal for this roll to work. So it may feel strange at first, but trust the process" Recommended MW: Stability.

Sneecher (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "A new Strand weapon enters the fray! I'm always excited to get a new weapon type to add to my toolbox, and this weapon immediately gives us the Outlaw/Hatchling combo I've been waiting for (I still love you Round Robin). I expect to have a lot of dumb fun with this gun in PVE, especially in activities with a Strand surge (AKA all of them this season). Warlocks in particular should enjoy this combo, especially with Thread of Evolution, the Classy Contender trait, and an Empowering rift. That being said, Threadlings aren't the strongest choice for endgame PVE, and Lightweight frame scouts aren't my favorite in GMs either, so I expect this will just be a roll for fun, rather than a top tier PVE weapon. If you are intent on using this for GMs, you'll want Explosive Payload or maybe even Focused Fury instead." Recommended MW: Stability.

Sneecher (PvP / M+KB): "PC players don’t need stability as much as I do, so you can trade all of those stability boosts for range, and really let the cones do the work for you. Outlaw and Kill Clip are a tried and true combo, so you can’t really go wrong here. Once again there are a few combos that work in PVP, so use whatever feels best for your playstyle." Recommended MW: Range.

Sneecher (PvP / Controller): "There are a lot of options for PVP on this weapon, which took me a bit by surprise. If you like scouts at all, I am sure there is a roll for you somewhere in here. As a console player myself, I thoroughly enjoy high stability rolls. Scouts have such good coverage that they can handle a slight hit to range in favor of landing more shots quickly. Encore is a perk I think a lot of people sleep on, but after the rework it can be very effective in 6v6 modes. Add No Distractions and the Omolon origin trait, and you’ve got a workhorse ready to excel in all stats." Recommended MW: Stability.

First-choice PvE pick for minor add clear in endgame activities. Named after a ghost that frightened horses at a particular spot on the Olympia race course during ancient games there. Our first Lightweight Strand scout rifle has only one direct kinetic slot competitor in Night Watch, and is pretty comparable in stats, although will do 10% less damage, as a non-kinetic weapon. For min-maxxers, the +30 Mobility from the intrinsic perk can help to flesh out builds. Taraxippos is fast-firing, so you will need to tidy up the 54 Recoil Direction. Arrowhead Brake in the barrel takes it to a manageable 84. In the magazine, Tactical Mag and Flared Magwell both offer useful boosts to stability and reload speed (and an extra shot for Tac Mag). Fourth Time's The Charm in the first trait column as your support perk is always welcome to extend your mag size, while Explosive Payload in the second column as the signature perk adds 30% damage with no falloff, and is useful when Scouts are the seasonal anti-Overload Champion mod, only needing two shots to disrupt. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Or, Omolon Fluid Dynamics adds stability and reload speed to the top half of your mag. Recommended MW: Range, Stability or Handling - just go with your preference, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod

For min-maxxers, the +30 Mobility from the intrinsic perk can help to flesh out builds. Taraxippos is fast-firing, so you will need to tidy up the 54 Recoil Direction. Chambered Compensator or Extended Barrel will get you to a slightly better 64. In the magazine, Tactical Mag and Flared Magwell both offer useful boosts to stability and reload speed (and an extra shot for Tac Mag). Fourth Time's The Charm in the first trait column as your support perk is always welcome to extend your mag size, or Outlaw works well for a snappy reload after a crit kill. Then Hatchling in the second column as the signature perk builds into the Strand toolkit - just come to peace that they're likely to be spawned too far away to join you, if you're a Warlock. The Classy Contender Origin Perk is useful - who would say no to extra class ability energy? Or, Omolon Fluid Dynamics adds stability and reload speed to the top half of your mag. Recommended MW: Range, Stability or Handling - just go with your preference, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod
